newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia says reconciled 71 pct of London Club debt.
newsitem.headline: Russia says reconciled 71 pct of London Club debt.

text.p: Russia has reconciled 71 percent of its debt to the London Club of commercial bank creditors, bringing the closing of the restructuring agreement one step closer, a senior Finance Ministry official said on Thursday.
"The level of debt fully reconciled reached 71 percent, which makes almost $17 billion," Deputy Finance Minister Mikhail Kasyanov told Reuters.
Last week the Finance Ministry said the volume of reconciled debt reached 70 percent after more than 340 creditors signed reconciliation statements.
Kasyanov said about 360 creditors had now returned reconciliation statements.
Russia has to reconcile 90 percent of the $24 billion principal of its $35 billion total debt, inherited from the former Soviet Union after its breakup, to close the agreement.
